notes.title: Demo with enemy AI
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello there!
[/h1]
After some significant work on custom game engine, we released new demo - with more player-friendly tutorial and a demo level with enemy AI. Made it just in time for Steam Next Fest. Although this note is written only now, demo was available from the very beginning of the festival! Overall, updates are as follows:

[list]
[*] Increased stability
[*] Works smooth on laptops
[*] Tutorial, that explains base mechanics
[*] Demo level, where mechanics can be tested
[/list]

Soon we will be updating screenshots and video, also will make AI more challenging.

Have a good day and fun a playthrough,
thundercatofdoom and CleDeSol
